data.headline: Beverage shelf stocking, stock rotation and mobile ordering
data.summary: They stock beverage shelves across several stores, rotate products by date and remove expired items. They also count missing stock, place orders in a phone app and drive between stores.

signals.rendering: They stock store shelves with beer and soft drinks for a brewery.
They drive to six or seven stores each day.
They check product dates, move older bottles to the front and remove expired items.
They count missing products and place stock orders using an app on their phone.
They prefer working independently without a supervisor constantly present.
